use_case: Revenue-management pricing: nightly rate recommendations and automatic publishing within approved bands for 88 hotels
business_owner: Hotels vice president of revenue management
vendor_or_model: Revenue-management vendor (machine learning forecasting and optimization, SaaS)
data_categories: Booking pace, rate and occupancy history, public competitor rates, events (vendor pooled benchmarking switched off 2026-08)
human_in_the_loop: Revenue managers set floors, ceilings, and daily change bands; changes above 25% need approval; emergency freeze at the 30 owned hotels since 2025, none yet at the 49 managed hotels with automatic publishing
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.160 (worked example of state price gouging laws, cautious reading); 16 CFR 464.2 (published rates feed total price display); FTC Act Sec. 5; antitrust counsel review of pooled competitor data
status: In production; continue with conditions (emergency freeze at managed hotels; contract bar on pooled data)

use_case: Guest chatbot on brand websites and app: answers questions and quotes rates and availability
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor (hosted large language model with retrieval over brand content and live rates)
data_categories: Guest questions; reservation lookups after sign-in; no card data (masked)
human_in_the_loop: Hands off to a contact center agent on request or low confidence; agents review flagged transcripts weekly
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 464.2 and 464.3 (total price; fee descriptions); FTC Act Sec. 5 (accuracy of claims); state breach laws for chat transcripts with reservation data; PCI DSS (no card data in chat)
status: In production; continue with conditions (total price fix by 2026-10-31; prompt-injection test; AI disclosure)

use_case: Dynamic ticket pricing for dated park tickets and separately ticketed events
vendor_or_model: Ticketing vendor pricing module (rules plus demand forecasting)
data_categories: Sales pace, attendance forecasts, weather; no personal data
human_in_the_loop: Pricing team sets bands; daily review on peak dates
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 464.2 (live-event tickets; general admission is a watch item); FTC Act Sec. 5
status: In production; inventory-level review only; council review due 2026-11-30

use_case: Ticket bot detection that blocks automated purchases of dated tickets and passes
data_categories: Device and behavior signals; IP addresses
human_in_the_loop: Blocked buyers can complete a challenge or call the contact center; weekly false-positive review
applicable_laws: FTC Act Sec. 5; state privacy laws for device data

use_case: Seasonal applicant screening: ranks applicants for park seasonal roles from application answers
data_categories: Applicant name, contact details, work history, availability, assessment answers
human_in_the_loop: Proposed design: recruiters review every ranked list; no automatic rejections
applicable_laws: Title VII and ADA (disparate impact and accommodation remain by statute); FCRA if the vendor acts as a consumer reporting agency (counsel); Colorado SB26-189 only if used for Colorado hiring (parks are in FL, TX, GA, TN, OH); Texas TRAIGA (intent-based prohibitions)
status: Proposed; not approved (P01 ATT-14); full impact assessment and bias testing required before any pilot

use_case: Credit model for timeshare purchase loans: scores applications, sets approve, decline, or refer, and generates adverse action reason codes
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted model on consumer report and application data
data_categories: Consumer reports; income; down payment; Social Security numbers (customer information under 16 CFR 314.2)
human_in_the_loop: Loan processors review every refer decision (about 22%); approvals and declines are automatic within policy; second-line review of a monthly sample
applicable_laws: ECOA and Regulation B, 12 CFR 1002.9(a)(1) and (b)(2) (specific principal reasons); FCRA adverse action duties when a consumer report is used (counsel); FTC Safeguards Rule (16 CFR 314.4); Colorado SB26-189 for Colorado applicants from 2027-01-01; CFPB Circular 2022-03 withdrawn 2025-05-12 but Reg B duties remain
status: In production; continue with conditions (reason codes; fair lending analysis; independent validation)

use_case: Inventory forecasting and rental model: forecasts owner use and reserves unused inventory for rental through the CRS
business_owner: Vacation Ownership vice president of revenue
vendor_or_model: In-house forecasting model on Cloud provider B
data_categories: Reservation history, owner points balances (aggregated), events, seasonality
human_in_the_loop: Revenue team approves weekly reservation releases above set thresholds
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 721.13(12)(a)-(c) (forecast and reserve in the best interests of owners as a whole; public offering statement disclosure; 5-year records); Fla. Stat. 721.071 (trade secret filing); 16 CFR 464.2 (vacation rental prices)
status: In production; continue with conditions (decision log by 2026-11-30)

use_case: Finger-scan gate matching for passholders and multi-day tickets at the 3 Florida parks
business_owner: Attractions vice president of park operations
vendor_or_model: Ticketing and gate vendor (biometric template matching)
human_in_the_loop: Gate staff resolve every mismatch with photo ID; no one is refused entry by the matcher alone
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171 (biometric data as defined in s. 501.702 is personal information; disposal under 501.171(8)); FTC Act Sec. 5; used only in Florida, so Illinois and Texas biometric statutes are not triggered (texts not reviewed)
status: In production; council review due 2026-10-31 with the retention fix (POAM-017)

use_case: Payment fraud scoring for online card transactions in all divisions
business_owner: Group Director of Payments and PCI Compliance
data_categories: Transaction data, device data, tokenized card data
human_in_the_loop: Rules team reviews decline rates weekly; guests can pay another way or call
applicable_laws: PCI DSS (vendor in the SYS-G4 scope); FTC Act Sec. 5

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant (drafting and summarizing) for corporate staff
vendor_or_model: Enterprise assistant service from a model provider (no training on group data; 30-day retention)
data_categories: Internal documents classed Internal or Confidential; no Restricted data
human_in_the_loop: Users review all output; prohibited for decisions about guests, owners, borrowers, applicants, or employees

use_case: Tour lead scoring: ranks hotel guests and park visitors for vacation ownership sales tour offers
vendor_or_model: Marketing analytics vendor model on SYS-G5 data
data_categories: Hotel stay and park visit history, loyalty tier, contact data from SYS-G5 (no children's data)
human_in_the_loop: Sales managers set campaign lists; guests can opt out
applicable_laws: FTC Act Sec. 5 (privacy notices must disclose the use; P03 G-087); state privacy laws, including CCPA opt-out rights for California guests; COPPA (kids' club data excluded)
status: In production; council review due 2026-10-31 with the notice change (P01 GR-13)
